attributes.diagnose: en mellemstor rørhat med gulbrun, karrygul til gylden hat og gule, ret grove rørmundinger. Hatkødet er hvidligt, men stokødet er svovlgult i basis, ligesom hyfestrengene. Stokken kan have et ± tydeligt, grovmasket net. Sporerne måler 9-14,5 x 4,5-7 μm, Q-gns 2,2. Vokser lysåbent med eg.
attributes.forvekslingsmuligheder: De gullige farver og især det gule kød i stokbasis er karakteristisk. Arten har lidt bredere sporer end de andre arter i grupper (Q-gns 2,3-2,7).

attributes.bogtekst_gyldendal_en:
Xerocomus chrysonema is a medium-sized bolete with a yellow-brown, curry-yellow to golden, felty cap and yellow, rather coarse pores. The cap flesh is whitish, but the stem flesh is sulphur-yellow at the base, as are the hyphal cords. The stem may have a ± distinct, coarse reticulum. The spores measure 9–14.5 × 4.5–7 µm, Qav. 2.2. Occurs with Quercus in parks.
The yellowish colours and the yellow flesh at the stem base are characteristic. The spores are, on average, somewhat wider than other species in Xerocomus.
Known from e.g. England, Sweden, Germany and the Czech Republic, probably rare; summer–autumn.
